title: Make Home your own
summary: Shape the home screen around how you actually watch.
includes: Hide the sections you don’t use, from the side menu, Home and Search
Open straight to your favorite page at startup (out in 2.4.3)
Set a display name for a personal greeting
A birthday surprise, Surprise me for your own files, and a look at what you’ve watched
Take things off Continue watching
reply: Built and being tested on Wii U now. The start screen came out in 2.4.3; the rest is planned for an upcoming update.

title: Display options
summary: A quieter interface, and video that fits the TV you have.
includes: Turn animated background effects off
Choose fit, stretch or letterbox in the player
4:3 pictures that fill a 4:3 screen, without black bars on every side (for CRTs)
reply: A Reduce motion switch that turns animations off is built for an upcoming update. Fit, stretch and letterbox are still to do, and so is 4:3 on a CRT (the report in #62). I haven’t started on those.

title: Type without the GamePad
summary: Type in search and other boxes with a Wii U Pro Controller or a Wii Remote, even when the GamePad’s screen is off.
includes: A keyboard drawn on the TV, moved with the D-pad or a stick
Used automatically when the GamePad screen is off or you last used another controller
The GamePad keeps the system keyboard
reply: Built and being tried on Wii U for an upcoming update.

title: Autoplay the next episode
summary: Keep a series rolling: continue to the next Jellyfin episode automatically, with an option to turn it off.

title: More servers and libraries
summary: Reach your media and books on more of the servers you already run at home.
includes: Browse and play files over FTP, including a phone acting as your media server
Calibre-Web and Kavita libraries, read in CoffeeFlix next to the local EPUB and CBZ reader
reply: I'm checking what the Wii U can handle before promising anything here.

title: YouTube account extras
summary: More from your signed-in YouTube account. Profile access and account compatibility need investigating.
includes: Like and dislike videos while signed in
YouTube Kids profile support
reply: Like and dislike (with the counts) and Kids profiles with their own YouTube are built and being tested for an upcoming update.

title: Community add-ons for YouTube
summary: Bring two popular community projects to CoffeeFlix.
includes: Return YouTube Dislike counts
Calmer titles and thumbnails in the spirit of DeArrow, with an option to see the originals
reply: Dislike counts from Return YouTube Dislike are built. For titles and thumbnails I made CoffeeFlix’s own DeArrow-style options (calmer titles, a frame from the video) instead of using the DeArrow service. Both are in testing for an upcoming update.

title: Twitch account and channel points
summary: Sign in to Twitch and see the channels you follow.
includes: Your followed channels
Collect channel points while you watch (Twitch has not allowed this so far)
reply: Signing in with a code from your phone works, and your followed channels show up, including after a restart. Channel points are the hard part: Twitch refused the app’s request to even look at a points balance, so I can’t promise earning or claiming them.

title: Watch more on Twitch
summary: More ways to enjoy a stream, beyond the live video.
includes: Past broadcasts (VODs) next to live streams
Chat with 7TV, BTTV and FrankerFaceZ emotes
Polls and predictions where possible
reply: Past broadcasts play and pick up where you left off on my Wii U. Chat with emotes, bigger text and an on-screen keyboard is built, and I’m still testing it on the console. Polls and predictions aren’t started.

title: Navidrome and Subsonic music servers
summary: Play your own music library from a Navidrome or other Subsonic-compatible server.
reply: A community pull request (#27) added this. It’s merged into my development version and being tested on Wii U for an upcoming update.

title: DVD playback
summary: Watch DVDs you own on the Wii U: disc images, VIDEO_TS folders and a USB DVD drive.
includes: Disc images (.iso, including split images) and VIDEO_TS folders
A title picker, chapters, subtitles and the audio language you choose
A disc in a USB DVD drive shows up on Home
Discs with copy protection are not played, and the app says so
Full DVD menus and music CDs are still only ideas
reply: Disc images and VIDEO_TS folders are in the supporter preview, and a test film played smoothly on a Wii U. Reading a disc from a USB DVD drive is built but still being worked out on the console. Next is more testing with burned discs.

title: Remember my subtitles
summary: Turn subtitles on once and they stay on the next time you open that show or video.
includes: Keep the subtitle language you chose for each show
Keep subtitles off when you turned them off

title: M3U playlists
summary: Open M3U playlists from the SD card or a USB drive and play your videos and music straight from them, like WiiMC.

title: Better photo viewing
summary: Photos from today’s phones and cameras that open quickly and look right.
includes: Fast thumbnails, even for large camera photos
Turn a photo, and phone photos stand upright on their own
Details: date taken, camera, size
A slideshow like the Wii Photo Channel, with music, that zooms in on one person and stays wide for a group
reply: Built and tried on Wii U. Large photos load much faster now. It’s planned for an upcoming update.

title: Search for the next video from the GamePad
summary: Pick what to watch next on the GamePad while the current video keeps playing on the TV.
includes: A search button in the remote’s Up next tab
Results replace the suggestions, one button goes back
reply: Built and being tried on Wii U for an upcoming update.

title: Supporter previews from Settings
summary: Update to supporter previews from Settings, with the email you used on Ko-fi, instead of downloading each one by hand.
includes: Type your Ko-fi email once in Settings > Updates and about
Previews arrive like a normal update, checked against a signature before anything is installed
Works on up to five consoles per supporter
reply: Built. It needs a one-time setup on my side, then it will switch on for supporters.

title: Play from USB sticks and hard drives
summary: Plug a USB stick or an external hard drive into the Wii U and play its videos, music and photos in CoffeeFlix.
includes: FAT32, exFAT and NTFS drives, the usual ones from a PC or a Mac
Read only: nothing is ever written to your drive
Subtitles, resume points and thumbnails work like they do on the SD card
Drives you plug in or pull out show up on their own
reply: Built and checked on a computer with real FAT32, exFAT and NTFS disks. It hasn’t run on a real Wii U yet, and the first thing to find out is whether the console lets apps read a USB drive at all.

title: Play more kinds of files
summary: Older and less common video and music files that didn’t play before: Windows Media, old phone videos, Flash video, RealMedia and more.
includes: Video: Windows Media (.wmv, .asf), phone videos (.3gp), Flash video (.flv), RealMedia (.rm), Ogg Theora (.ogv) and camcorder files (.mts)
Music: Windows Media Audio (.wma), AIFF, Monkey’s Audio (.ape), AMR, and AC-3, E-AC-3 and DTS files
reply: Added to the Wii U build and played from start to finish in a Wii U emulator. The console’s processor plays these, so they’re best at standard definition. HEVC (H.265), VP9 and AV1 are still too heavy for the Wii U.

title: Your Wii U games in CoffeeFlix
summary: See the Wii U and Wii Virtual Console games installed on your console, with their pictures, and start one from CoffeeFlix.
includes: A Games section with your installed games and their icons
A Recently played row on Home
Play modes for Wii Virtual Console games
reply: A community pull request (#53) added this. It’s in my development version and the supporter preview. Starting a game from CoffeeFlix first crashed the Wii U Menu; that is fixed and it works for Wii U games on my console. Wii Virtual Console games and games on a USB drive still need testing.

title: More from Radio
summary: Add a station by its stream address, jump back to what you played lately, and listen to BBC local radio.
includes: A heart on Now Playing keeps a station, and favorites come first
Add your own station with a name and a stream address
A Recently played shelf
BBC local radio and BBC stations that play in the UK
Stations such as LBC, Capital and Classic FM connect instead of timing out
Lists open at once, and station logos are kept for next time

title: RomM game library
summary: Browse your RomM retro-game library from the Wii U and download games to the SD card.
includes: Connect with your server address and an API token
Browse your platforms and games with cover art and details
Download a game to a folder on the SD card
